description: Ministry of Higher Education and High Ways - Order to amend by adding "10. Dept. of International Studies, 11. Dept. of Social Statistics , 12. Dept. of Political Science" Ex. Ord. No. 1454/37 of 22.07.2006
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order issued under statutory authority (Section 27(1) of the Act) that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments of the University of Kelaniya. While it mentions a minister's name (Lakshman Kiriella), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than announcing a personnel change or detailing portfolio responsibilities.
